name: Growing Up
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of raising children with intentional guidance and spiritual nurture, as seen in Proverbs 22:6 and Ephesians 6:4, which instruct parents to train and bring up their children in the Lord's ways. The growth of Jesus in wisdom, stature, and favor (Luke 2:40, 2:52) serves as the perfect example of maturing in both physical and spiritual dimensions. Furthermore, Ephesians 4 highlights the role of church leaders and the community in helping believers grow in Christ, encouraging maturity through truth spoken in love, ultimately growing up into Christ, the head.
